title: Elon Musk on Cameras vs LiDAR for Self Driving and Autonomous Cars
summary: A clip from Tesla Autonomy Day 2019 where Elon Musk argues cameras are enough for self-driving and calls lidar a fool's errand.
why: Cited in self-driving threads as the source of Tesla's vision-only stance, usually to discuss or push back on it.
